about_the_game:
A cozy idle creature-collector that keeps growing while you rest


Welcome to a magical forest filled with adorable little monsters. Hatch eggs, raise pals from common to rare and watch them evolve as you feed them, keep them happy, and care for their health. Expand a gentle farm and a tiny forest hotel, set up smart automations, then relax. Your valley keeps earning coins even when the game is minimized or your PC is off.

Productive and relaxing, at the same time

Built-in Pomodoro productivity timer helps you focus in short bursts while your pals do the work. Use the optional transparent window mode to keep the cozy forest in view without covering your desktop. Play for a minute, get back to work, come back to new surprises, micro-stress free.

Features

  • Raise & Evolve – feed, play, and care for happiness/health to unlock charming evolutions from common to rare.

  • Eggs & Collection – hatch adorable pet, and collect them all. 

  • Farm & Forest Hotel – plant and harvest foods, host guests and collect all the gift.

  • True Idle/Offline Progress – earn resources while minimized or offline, with fair caps to avoid pressure.

  • Pomodoro + Transparent Window – focus timer, gentle chimes, and an optional see-through game window for productivity.

  • Cozy Aesthetics  – pastel palette, day–night cycle, soft ambience, fireflies, and sparkles.

Play at your pace

This is a laid-back, aesthetic idle game perfect for quick check-ins or long, cozy sessions. No harsh deadlines, no fear of missing out. Just cute monsters, gentle progress, and a forest that feels alive.

Fair by design


No pay-to-win. Golden tickets and special items are earned through play. We want the loop to feel satisfying, not exhausting.

Wishlist now to follow updates, new pals, seasonal events, and fresh decorations for your valley!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-4130 / AMD Athlon X4 860K (2 core)
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 4600 / GeForce GTX 650 / Radeon HD 7750 (≈2 GB VRAM), DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard & mouse
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8192 MB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 750 Ti / Radeon R7 260X atau Intel UHD 620 (iGPU modern), DirectX 11
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2000 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Any onboard
  • Additional Notes: SSD recomended; 1080p GPU 2 GB VRAM

Stay productive with transparent-window mode and a Pomodoro timer. Offline progress. Aesthetic and relaxing. Collect your monsters!
